title: Information Theoretic Measures for Fairness-aware Feature Selection
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Religion is mentioned once in a footnote as an example of a protected attribute, but it is not used in the theoretical development or the experimental evaluation. The framework is general and could potentially be applied to religion, but the paper itself does not conduct such an analysis.

measurement_description: The paper develops a framework to measure fairness and discrimination in feature selection for machine learning models. While religion is mentioned as a potential protected attribute in a legal context, the actual experiments and benchmarks in the paper do not measure anything related to faith or religion. The experiments focus on race as the protected attribute.
